application_hold_points: F1 DC breaking capacity and pre-arcing/total clearing I2t must be coordinated with actual supply short-circuit current, wiring, MOSFETs and copper. 0476015.MRSN is not the MRS high-interrupt suffix.
Check F1 temperature derating at 10 A continuous in the compact enclosure; 25% baseline derating leaves 11.25 A before ambient derating.

Auxiliary input remains 12..24 V; Sunlord winding maximum is 30 V DC, so these parts must never be moved into the 60 V power bus. Confirm transient differential voltage, operating peak/ripple current and temperature.
HCTL signal headers are rated 1 A per contact. Confirm external sensor-power budget; use the documented 2 A JST PH alternative for J7 if it must exceed that rating.
Power solder holes have no independent rated-current certificate; verify plated barrel, solder fill, copper spreading and thermal performance with actual wires, plus strain relief.
Confirm all connector mating-harness orientation from physical pin-1 markings before assembly. A single-row 1.27 mm header is not a standard 10-pin ARM SWD plug.

SW1 R8/AUX_SHDN_N bias must be checked by the circuit owner before approving the 12 V rated tactile switch; present XML pulls SHDN toward AUX through100k despite the TPS26600 recommended0..4 V limit. No electrical edits made here.
